verdicts.reason: A turns the layout into a proper left-to-right banner: a two-line headline at a readable size on the left and the dark CTA pill on the right. The hierarchy and brand colours survive. Its only flaws are minor: the margins are tight, and the CTA label is small. B just shrinks the stacked original into a 50px-tall strip. The one-line headline is tiny, and the CTA pill below it is so small its label is barely readable. Both are crammed into the centre, which wastes the width and makes the CTA hard to see.
